about: The hook on each page a reader is sent to (ADR-132, A hook on every page): one entry a page, what its first screen says before anything else. The React build reads this file for the landing, a blog post, the Quality page and the review route; the API reads it for /about and the resume door. Every line is copied word for word from the source it names, and a count is never typed here: {recommendations} is read from data/recommendations.json when the page is drawn.

next_about: Where next (ladder v7, page flow): at the foot of each public page, at most two links, each with one line of reason and the minutes it takes. The React build reads it for the landing, the review route, a blog post, the Quality page, a decision record and Architecture; the API reads it for /about and the resume door. No address here opens Admin. The contact line is /api/go/email, a recorded redirect to Steve's email, so no page carries the address. The landing and the review route lead to the post named by slug. A spoke's first link is the review page: a blog post and About lead first to /?view=review. A count a reason names is written in braces, {recommendations}, and filled from data/recommendations.json when the page is drawn.
